question: Does waiting for a causal liquidity or structure event improve the frozen S20 OB+OI candidate stream enough to survive stress costs?
parent: S20_ob_oi_patient_runner: frozen OB + OI candidates, structural stop, activation at 1.5R, 2.5 ATR trail, 8R cap, 240 minute maximum hold
data: same checksum-verifiable Binance minute, funding and 5m metrics archives as S20

entry_policies.MARKET_TOUCH: control: unchanged parent signal, market at the next executable 1m open
entry_policies.SWEEP_RECLAIM: parent touch bar must sweep the prior eight completed 15m lows/highs and close directionally back through that level; parent market timing unchanged
entry_policies.MSS_BREAK: within 30 minutes after the parent signal, the first completed 5m directional candle must close beyond the touch-bar high/low by 0.03 ATR; market at the next 1m open
entry_policies.MSS_RETEST: same MSS confirmation, then a 30-minute resting limit at the broken touch-bar high/low; no market chase

isolated_variable: Only entry timing/price changes. Parent candidate formation, direction, stop, sizing, risk halts and S20 patient-runner management are identical.
selection_on_train_stress: eligible requires >=40 fills, net PnL >0, PF >1.05 and mean net R >0; choose highest mean net R, then PF, then fixed policy order; if none passes choose CASH
combined_oos_gate_per_fixed_policy: at least 40 fills, net PnL >0, PF >1.0, mean net R >0, positive stress PnL in both test folds, and one-sided day-block bootstrap lower bound above zero at alpha 0.0125 (Bonferroni for four policies)
research_sequence: Stage A only. Stops and management are not searched. Only an entry policy passing the combined OOS gate may enter a separately frozen Stage B stop/management study.
no_parameter_search: Exactly four predeclared policies and one parameter set. All four count as trials; failure closes S120 v1.
